meta.title: Predictive Mastery Map: grounded corpus (v2)
meta.description: Knowledge blocks for enterprise ML prediction. Each block maps to a real, named unit in a reputable ML/DL corpus (corpus+unit+URL). difficulty = foundations(0) -> frontier(1). domain drives colour; ucs = which of the 25 use cases require the block; prereqs = hand-curated direct prerequisites (the 'learn first' edges).
meta.sourcing: No invented blocks. Vision/NLP-only units excluded as out-of-scope for tabular/time-series enterprise prediction. Prerequisites are hand-authored, not auto-derived.
